name: Be Back
source:
Main heroine returns to the home town for the first time in four years since breaking up with her boyfriend and changing school. Town name can be translated as "beyond the field of God". But she is yet to discover that.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角与男友分手转学四年后首次回到家乡。镇名可译为“超越神域”。但她还没有发现这一点。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
